## Luma Uni-1 Max API

Luma Uni-1 Max is an image generation and image editing model by Luma AI, available on the Venice API as `luma-uni-1-max`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

### Luma Uni-1 Max API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `luma-uni-1-max` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.12 / image |
| `luma-uni-1-max-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.13 / edit |

### Luma Uni-1 Max specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Luma AI |
| Released | Jun 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, 2:3 |
| Prompt limit | 6,000 characters |

### How to use the Luma Uni-1 Max API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "luma-uni-1-max"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "luma-uni-1-max",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
